uncertain: The 2014 points for both series have no printed numeric labels, so exact 2014 percentages must be inferred from vertical position rather than read from text.
Axis tick values are not legible, so absolute percentage values cannot be confirmed; only relative vertical ordering of the two 2014 markers is directly observable.

Color-to-series binding is ambiguous: the left axis is labeled 'Agriculture (%)' in blue while the right axis is labeled 'Industry (%)' in red, but the blue line uses circular markers and the red line uses square markers, so it is unclear whether blue represents Agriculture or Industry.
